routes.name: Indian Summer
routes.overview: A 7-pitch, 5.10- granite rock climb up Dome Peak's South Face, established as a new route around September 2, 2011 — a rarely-repeated alternative to the standard Dome Glacier route for parties seeking real rock climbing on the peak.
routes.approach: Western approach (the recommended option): roughly 10 miles with about 7,800 ft of gain via the Ptarmigan Traverse trail toward Spire Point — described as a 'brutal approach' with significant bushwhacking. A longer eastern approach via Chelan also exists but adds a full extra day each way.
